rssiguard.title: Minimum RSSI
rssiguard.intro_tips: Clients whose signal stays below the floor are disconnected and briefly blocked, so they associate somewhere with a better link. With only one access point in range there is nowhere else to go: a disconnected client simply loses service until the block expires.
rssiguard.threshold_tips: -75 dBm is a usable floor, -80 lenient, -70 aggressive.
rssiguard.strikes_tips: Signal swings a few dB between samples, so a client must stay below the floor this many polls in a row.
rssiguard.ban_time_tips: A disconnected client re-associates within a second. Without a short block, nothing changes. 0 disconnects without blocking.
rssiguard.grace_tips: Ignore a client for this long after it connects, while the link settles.
rssiguard.observing_note: Signals are being watched, but nobody is disconnected while this is off. Use the list below to pick a threshold, then switch it on.
